evidence: Formal metadata declares FailFast=true, while persisted and direct DTO flows can omit the parameter.
ForEachOperator now uses true when FailFast is absent; Sprint2_ForEachTests covers the missing case and verifies that explicit false still wins.
reviewEntries.reason: The old false fallback changed loop termination on a production-reachable legacy/DTO path. The runtime fallback now matches formal metadata without overriding an explicit value.

evidence: Formal metadata provides http://localhost:5000/api for normal authoring, but HttpRequest execution and validation reject a structurally absent Url.
ProjectService and FlowEntityMapper can reconstruct historical or direct DTO operators without the field, so the fail-closed branch is reachable.
reviewEntries.reason: An absent network target is intentionally rejected instead of silently authorizing a localhost request. This safety difference remains separate from normal metadata-default authoring.

evidence: Formal authoring metadata supplies C:\ClearVision\NG_Images, while a structurally absent Directory/FolderPath fails before any file write.
The missing-field branch is reachable through historical persisted flows and direct DTO construction.
reviewEntries.reason: The fail-closed runtime branch prevents an omitted output target from silently writing to a machine-local path. It is retained as an intentional side-effect safety boundary.

evidence: Formal metadata declares NG_{yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}_{Guid}.jpg, while the old absent-field path produced image_{timestamp}.png.
ImageSaveOperator now uses and expands the formal template; ImageSaveOperatorTests observes the resulting JPG name and existing tests preserve explicit canonical and legacy values.
reviewEntries.reason: The missing filename changed both the external filename and image format. The fallback and token expansion now match the formal metadata contract.

evidence: Formal metadata supplies port 5002 for normal authoring, while ResolveConnectionSettings treats an absent operator endpoint as incomplete unless global fallback is explicitly enabled.
Historical and direct DTO flows can omit the field, but execution admission remains a separate prerequisite for real PLC I/O.
reviewEntries.reason: The zero fallback is a fail-closed signal paired with missing IP handling; changing only the port would not create a complete endpoint and could weaken explicit PLC configuration requirements.

evidence: MqttPublish metadata marks the operator maturity as placeholder-disabled and Execute always returns MQTT_PUBLISH_DISABLED without publishing.
Validation rejects a structurally absent Broker even though normal authoring supplies localhost.
reviewEntries.reason: The current difference is a deliberate fail-closed validation boundary on a disabled integration; there is no enabled production publish path whose broker behavior can be regressed.

evidence: MqttPublish is explicitly placeholder-disabled and never performs a real publish.
A missing Topic is rejected before the disabled-integration result, while normal authoring metadata supplies cv/results.
reviewEntries.reason: Keeping a missing publish destination fail-closed is intentional until a real MQTT client and execution lifecycle are enabled and reviewed.

evidence: Execution has a DM100 compatibility fallback, but ValidateParameters requires a structurally present address.
The missing-field validation branch is reachable through historical persisted and direct DTO operators.
reviewEntries.reason: PLC memory addresses remain fail-closed at validation so an omitted field cannot silently select DM100 for a real read or write.

evidence: Metadata declares 1000000000 while the absent-field fallback is double.MaxValue.
A behavioral difference requires Operation=Filter, an omitted FilterMaxX, and input coordinates above 1000000000; no formal production fixture or saved project proving that combination was found.
reviewEntries.reason: The static difference is real, but production impact is not established. It remains a candidate rather than being changed to reduce finding count.

evidence: ValidateParameters uses 1 when OuterRadius is structurally absent, while Execute derives half of the input image size and metadata declares 100.
Historical or direct DTO construction can reach the absent-field path, but the repository does not establish whether the adaptive image-size fallback is an intentional legacy contract.
reviewEntries.reason: The three-way difference needs product intent and legacy-project evidence before changing geometry behavior, so it remains a candidate.

evidence: Formal metadata declares AngleRange=180, while both execution and validation previously fell back to 0.
PyramidShapeMatchOperator now uses 180 for absent values; DefaultFallbackGovernanceTests reads the real MatcherConfig and verifies explicit 15 still wins.
reviewEntries.reason: The old fallback disabled angular search on production-reachable incomplete flows. Runtime and validation now match formal metadata.

evidence: Formal metadata declares Result is {0} and {1}, while a structurally absent Template falls back to an empty string and concatenates inputs.
ProjectService and direct DTO construction can produce an operator without the field, making the output difference observable in formal execution.
reviewEntries.reason: This is a confirmed production-reachable output difference, but it remains open because the round is capped at five fixes and higher-risk file, state, flow-control, and matching issues were prioritized.

evidence: Formal metadata declares ResetThreshold=100, while the old absent-field fallback was 0.
VariableIncrementOperator now uses 100; operator tests cover missing and explicit thresholds, and ProjectServiceTests covers save/load materialization followed by real Execute.
reviewEntries.reason: The old fallback could reset state on nearly every positive counter value. The runtime now preserves the formal threshold and explicit values.

evidence: Formal metadata declares StaticValue=0, while the old missing fallback was an empty string.
VariableWriteOperator now uses 0; VariableWriteOperatorTests observes a missing Int static value writing zero while existing explicit-value tests remain unchanged.
reviewEntries.reason: The missing static value changed persisted state and could fail numeric conversion. Runtime fallback now matches metadata without overriding upstream or explicit values.

evidence: ResolveSampleCount reads SampleCount with sentinel 0 only to distinguish an absent canonical value from a configured value.
The same helper then reads legacy NumSamples with fallback 24 and clamps it to the metadata range, so an operator missing both fields effectively uses 24.
reviewEntries.reason: The static analyzer reports the intermediate sentinel but the observable missing-parameter result already equals the formal metadata default. No production defect is present.
